name: Big Head
steps: Use the zip file to compress the head.
Make the head do a hula hoop exercise.
Exhaust the brain cells to reduce the head size.
Use the iron to straighten the hair.
Put the head in the washing machine spin cycle.
Feed the character to make the body look bigger.
Use thermal expansion and contraction to shrink the head.
Apply the constriction tool to make the head smaller and complete the level.
